# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a section when a frame first asks for 4 of its shaders,
# so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give
# RT64 a list of the game's shaders"). A description in two sections is built once.
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing (2026-10-13, the page's default settings): bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header
# says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh
# for each section, and patches/shader_survey.c starts a new game or warps to each area as the game's own map select
# does, with the debug save (every item and mask). Above the first section: the launcher, the logos, the title screen
# and file select (a file named, erased, opened). Then the attract demo the title screen plays when left alone; and a
# section a region, each of its scenes arrived at, walked, the camera turned, a sword swung, the first-person view and
# the pause menu's four screens: Clock Town (day, night, the third day, Skull Kid on the roof), its houses, shops and
# fairy fountain; the intro of a new game (the Lost Woods, the fall, the curse, Deku Link under the Clock Tower and in
# it, with the Happy Mask Salesman); Termina Field (day, night, the rain of day 2, day 3, the bow and the ocarina)
# with the Observatory and the grottos; the swamp, Deku Palace and Woodfall; Woodfall Temple, Odolwa and the Chamber
# of Giants; the mountain, Goron Village and the racetrack; Snowhead Temple and Goht; Great Bay, Zora Hall and the
# Pirates' Fortress; Great Bay Temple and Gyorg; Ikana, its graveyard, canyon, well and castle, Stone Tower; Stone
# Tower Temple both ways up and Twinmold; Romani Ranch and Milk Road; the Moon, its four trials and Majora. Link is
# Deku in the swamp and Clock Town, Goron on the mountain, Zora in Great Bay, each form in its Moon trial and Fierce
# Deity against Majora, human elsewhere and in each temple too. The last section, "earlier", is the descriptions of
# the list played by hand before (2026-10-12) that this recording never printed. Clock Town comes before the intro,
# which draws much of it: a frame builds the section that holds the most of the shaders it wants, the earlier of two
# that hold as many, and every game but a new one starts in Clock Town. A section's name is one word.
#
# Clock Town, its houses, Termina Field and Woodfall Temple each have a second load in the plan that plays where the
# first walks, with shader_survey.js's helpers: Deku Link's bubble in South Clock Town; the town's shooting gallery;
# the Pictograph Box, the Blast Mask, the Lens of Truth, the Bunny Hood and fire and ice arrows among Termina Field's
# enemies; Odolwa's fight with the bow, bombs and the hookshot. The 20 descriptions a long play of the page
# (2026-10-18) missed there are in those sections, put there by hand; its fights with Goht, Gyorg, Twinmold, Igos and
# Majora drew nothing the list lacks.
#
# Not recorded: the other minigames, the final cutscenes and credits; RT64 builds what the list misses behind the game,
# and the page remembers it for the next visit. Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change
# to one of those defaults means recording again.
